name: Camp WANNAGOAGAIN!
description_short: A week-long day camp at Buck Hill Scout Reservation for children, teens, and young adults with autism and related social-emotional or communication challenges, with visual supports, a low camper-to-counselor ratio, and 1:1 support when needed. In 2026 it added a third week just for adult campers (18+).
special_needs_notes: For campers with autism and related social-emotional or communication challenges. Supports include visual supports, a low camper-to-counselor ratio, 1:1 support when needed, structured teaching methods, sensory-based activities, relaxation techniques for self-regulation, and daily living routines. The camp director decides which week each camper attends after reviewing the application.
swim_waterfront_notes: Camp facilities include a lake. Activities include swimming and boating. The page gives no details on swim supervision or swim tests.
